task: cross-chain GPU validator correctness and runtime-contract hardening

repository.head: 76d64f2f1b6af6d7da60fc809cf8bc558983372b
repository.note: The shared checkout contained unrelated user and agent changes throughout this task.

implementation: Wired Ed25519 verification into SVM and ED25519-configured adapters.
Restored native Solana and Cosmos configurations alongside the generated EVM chain list.
Added Ed25519 GPU/CPU verification with fail-closed GPU-required mode.
Corrected Secp256k1 CPU verification, including compressed SEC1 public keys and curve validation.
Removed SHA3-for-Keccak fallback and added a known Keccak-256 vector.
Fixed cluster lock reentrancy, lane breaker failover, stale signer leases, and batch limits.
Repaired Docker build paths, CLI commands, compose structure, and relocated deployment paths.

mypy_scoped.result: No issues in 14 changed source files

rust.command: cargo fmt -p <focused-package> -- --check for pallet-meme-overlord, pallet-x3-consensus, and pallet-x3-atomic-kernel

workspace_format.detail: cargo fmt --all -- --check reports formatting drift in crates/x3-verification-router from concurrent shared-checkout work

skips: CUDA kernel execution tests: nvcc is not installed
Polkadot adapter test: SR25519 is not implemented by the Ed25519 kernel
One multi-GPU source-contract test: opcode.rs is absent from the expected path

remaining_blockers: CUDA toolkit/nvcc is not installed, so no GPU kernel was compiled, loaded, or executed on the two available NVIDIA GPUs.
A Docker daemon was unavailable, so images were statically validated but not built or launched.
SR25519 Substrate verification remains outside the Ed25519 GPU path and must use native Substrate verification.
Whole-workspace rustfmt is currently blocked by unrelated formatting drift in crates/x3-verification-router; all three focused Rust packages pass rustfmt.
